long_biography.plain_text:
Pappas began as a Salzburg automotive business built by Alexander Pappas's father, Georg, and uncle Dimitri around Mercedes-Benz distribution and retail. Georg transferred the holding company to Alexander and his sister, Catharina, who took over the family enterprise in 2005. Alexander became the public-facing chief, reorganising the group and consolidating its operations around a new Salzburg headquarters.

The siblings later separated their main business responsibilities. Catharina assumed the automotive holding, while Alexander turned to the family's property division and investment portfolio. He remains a managing director of MB-Immobilien, Trebitsch Immobilien and related Salzburg holding companies. These roles support an operating identity in property and asset management rather than a passive connection to the family fortune.
